F-B.3.4_root_cause.title: CIPHER substrate CUDA 12 vs container PyTorch CUDA 13 version skew - GOT patches the wrong library
F-B.3.4_root_cause.cipher_substrate_built_against: CUDA 12 toolkit at Phase A close (1d91e7da); DT_NEEDED libcublas.so.12, libcublasLt.so.12, libcudart.so.12, libcusolver.so.11; GOT patcher matches on CUDA 12 SOnames
F-B.3.4_root_cause.mechanism_failure: R4 bind-mounts host CUDA 12 toolkit into /usr/lib/cipher/ so libcipher_rt.so loads. Substrate's GOT patcher then finds and patches CUDA 12 cuBLAS modules (26 modules, 4 targets). BUT torch's actual matmul path uses CUDA 13 libcublas (loaded by torch from /usr/local/lib/python3.12/dist-packages/nvidia/cu13/lib/libcublas.so.13). The two cuBLAS instances are disjoint - CIPHER's GOT patches a library that torch doesn't call into.
F-B.3.4_root_cause.GATE_A_SHIM_CALLS: 0 (substrate loaded; substrate's GOT-patched cuBLAS not exercised; MATMUL calls=0 handled=0 passthrough=0)
